title: Salary slip input
description: Every field is optional except the ones the CLI needs to make a wage slip; missing ones fall back to the template's defaults. Files passed to the CLI merge left to right (employer file, employee file, month file).

employerName.description: Name of the establishment, as registered

employerRef.description: Registration numbers under the name, e.g. LIN or GSTIN; shown under the address

slipNo.description: Wage slip number, e.g. PAY/2627/EMP01/08; never reuse one

issueDate.description: Date the slip is issued, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

month.description: Wage period, as YYYY-MM (a calendar month)

employeeGuardian.description: Father's, mother's or spouse's name (Form V asks for it)

department.description: Department, if the employer uses them

esiNumber.description: ESI insurance number, if the employee is covered

bankAccount.description: Bank account the wages are paid into

ifsc.description: an 11-character IFSC like ICIC0001190, or empty

daysPaid.description: Days paid in the month; defaults to the days in the month less lopDays

lopDays.description: Days of loss of pay (unpaid leave) in the month, default 0

name.description: Allowance name, e.g. Conveyance, Special allowance

allowances.description: Other allowances, each with a name and an amount

state.description: State where the employee works; decides the professional tax. Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh are in rules/professional-tax.json

gender.description: Used only where a state's professional tax differs for men and women (Maharashtra)

autoDeductions.description: Compute PF, ESI and professional tax from rules/ instead of taking pf, esi and professionalTax as given

pfApplicable.description: Whether the establishment/employee is covered by EPF; with autoDeductions, false leaves PF out

esiApplicable.description: Whether the establishment is covered by ESIC; with autoDeductions, false leaves ESI out

esiDisability.description: Employee is a person with disability, for whom the ESI wage ceiling is higher

pf.description: Employee's provident fund contribution; overwritten when autoDeductions is true

esi.description: Employee's ESI contribution; overwritten when autoDeductions is true

professionalTax.description: Professional tax for the month; overwritten when autoDeductions is true

tds.description: Tax deducted at source on salary for the month, as worked out by the employer or a CA

name.description: Deduction name, e.g. Canteen, Loan instalment

otherDeductions.description: Any other deduction, each with a name and an amount

deductionBasis.description: How PF, ESI and professional tax were worked out; filled by the tool when autoDeductions is true

notes.description: Free text below the amount in words, e.g. a remark on leave

signName.description: Name of the person signing for the employer
